base.shared_note: This is a shared demo for the jury, hosted in Switzerland (Microsoft Azure, Zurich). Please use the example letters only, never a real one. Other visitors can break services too; Demo controls repair them.
base.footer: A prototype for the Swiss {ai} Weeks. The commune and every letter here are fictional. Explanations are not legal advice.
home.title: A letter from the commune you don't understand?
home.lead: Paste it below or upload it. We explain it in simple words and in your language, tell you what to do and by when, and write a reply in German that you can check and send.
home.placeholder: Paste the text of your letter here, or pick an example on the right.
home.upload_simulated: Demo: reading photos and PDFs is simulated. We filled in the example letter “{subject}”. Check the text before you continue.
home.upload_text: Text read from {file}. Check it before you continue.
home.upload_failed: This file could not be read. Paste the text instead.
home.fine: This is an explanation, not legal advice. You decide what to send.
home.promise_why: Which rule applies depends on the office that wrote the letter. Letters from the social services talk about your support, your health and your children. The law protects this information more strongly than almost anything else, so those letters never leave Switzerland.
service.social.rule_line: Rule of the social services: Switzerland only.
service.social.promise: [[Only services in Switzerland]] read your letter. If none is available, it waits here, safely, until one is.
service.social.allows: as the social services' rule allows
service.school.rule_line: Rule of the school: Switzerland first, then the EU.
service.school.promise: [[Services in Switzerland]] read your letter first. If none can answer, services in the EU may. Never anywhere else.
service.info.rule_line: Rule of this office: Switzerland and the EU; elsewhere only if you agree.
service.info.promise: [[Services in Switzerland and the EU]] read your letter. A service anywhere else only if you agree, for this letter only.

consent.title: Send this letter to a service in the United States?
consent.intro: No service in Switzerland or the EU can answer right now. If you agree:
consent.point1: a service in the United States receives [[your whole letter]], including your name, your address and any numbers in it;
consent.point2: Swiss data protection law does not apply there in the same way, and authorities there may be able to access it;
consent.point3: this cannot be undone once it is sent. It applies to this letter only.
consent.recorded: Your choice is recorded in the journey of your letter.
consent.check: I understand and I agree for this letter.
consent.agree: Send it to the United States

ep.why.EU: In the EU: school and other offices only
ep.why.US: In the United States: only if a resident agrees
ep.why.unknown: Never used: its location is unknown

demo.title: Demo controls
demo.intro: Break the services on purpose and watch what happens to the letter. Real means the Public AI API, behind a local switch. Simulated services only show where a request went.
demo.foot: “Received” counts what actually reached each service. Services a rule excludes must stay at zero for letters under that rule. Social services: Switzerland only. School: Switzerland, then the EU. Other offices: Switzerland and the EU; the United States only if the resident agrees.
demo.lead: Open a letter in another window, then break services here and watch its journey.
